The '''Geonosian Arenas''' were [[Monument]]s constructed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They were constructed by Geonosian Workers at a cost of 3000 units each of [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]], [[Ore/Legends|ore]] and [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]]. The Arenas resembled the [[Petranaki arena]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], which had been the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|literal starting point]] of the Clone Wars.

==Behind the scenes==
Geonosian Arenas appear in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Wikipedia:Computer game expansion pack|expansion pack]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''. In multiplayer, players can build monuments such as this one, and if defended for 200 in-game "days," can win the scenario.
